source: Production systems should therefore version the embedding contract alongside the index. Useful metadata includes model identifier, revision, preprocessing template, role/instruction, output dimension, normalization convention, and metric.
zh: 因此，生产系统应该将嵌入合约与索引一起版本化。有用的元数据包括模型标识符、修订版、预处理模板、角色/指令、输出维度、标准化约定和度量。
